messages.content: Follow the output format exactly. Do not explain.
Return a JSON object with one key numbers whose value is the array of integers from 1 to 60 inclusive. No markdown.
Apply the stated rules. Return only a JSON object with the requested final state, without markdown.

Initial itinerary: flight arrival 9; transfer duration 2; attraction starts 12, duration 2, flexible=true; dinner fixed start 17; hotel checkin deadline 22. Intervention: flight arrival changes to 13. Rules: transfer end=arrival+transfer duration. Attraction needs one hour after transfer; if original start is too early, move attraction start to transfer end+1. Attraction end=start+duration. Dinner readiness=max(transfer end,attraction end); dinner status=missed if readiness>17, otherwise scheduled. Checkin hour=dinner readiness+1; checkin status=late if checkin hour>22, otherwise on_time. Return exactly the keys transfer_end, attraction_start, attraction_end, dinner_status, checkin_hour, checkin_status.

limitations: Historical comparison only; requested model alias differs from old route.
